title: LaTeX for Academic Writing
tagline: Create professional academic documents effortlessly -- Master LaTeX for research papers, theses, and technical publications.
overview: This course transforms your academic and technical writing process using LaTeX. You'll learn to create beautifully formatted documents, including research papers, theses, presentations, and books.

The course covers everything from basic document structure to advanced customization, including bibliography management with BibTeX, mathematical typesetting, and journal-specific formatting requirements. You'll save countless hours on formatting while producing publication-ready documents.
learningOutcomes: Create professional documents with proper structure and formatting
Master mathematical typesetting for equations and symbols
Manage bibliographies and citations using BibTeX
Create presentations with Beamer and posters
Design custom templates and document classes
Generate tables, figures, and algorithms properly
Work with multi-file projects and large documents

targetAudience.title: Research Scholars
targetAudience.description: PhD students and researchers writing theses, papers, and academic documents.
